title: TX queue invalid priority and deadline inputs mutate state before failure
description: Post-fix correctness review: `TxQueue.push(..., priority=1)` inserts an entry and increments stats before raising while evaluating `priority.name`; malformed deadlines can enqueue entries that later break expiry comparisons. Validate and normalize priority, data, deadline, channel, and reservation flags before any expiry, stats, order, LRU, entry, or reservation mutation. Add int, bool, NaN, and string boundary tests that prove invalid calls are atomic no-ops.
